description: Four ad-hoc runs of one location target, each with a worker log at its claim and a nested session that shares one SQL text with the others and keeps one of its own. Runs ended 20 days ago, 2 hours ago and 1 hour ago; the fourth is still running. Keeping 14 days and 1 run drops the first two logs whole, keeps the shared SQL, and leaves every run, its nodes and the scheduler's events.
